Issue 4701: the array declared at the top is written once and never read anywhere, so both
the module-level allocation and the single write instruction inside main are dead and the
issue asks for both to be removed. In the DXC panes they are both still present: one
module-level line above `define void @main`, and one instruction in the body.

The last DXC pane compiles the identical source with -DUSE_STATIC, which changes only that
array's storage class from group-shared to file-scope static. Its `main` body is empty and
the module-level line is gone -- so the compiler does perform this transform, just not for
group-shared memory. That contrast is the report.

The two clang panes repeat the same A/B against the HLSL front end in clang, for comparison.

The FXC pane is for comparison only; it emits DXBC rather than DXIL, so read it for whether
a thread-group-shared declaration appears at all, not for a matching instruction listing.

Compiler Explorer adds -Zi -Qembed_debug to DXC panes, so the shader text itself is echoed
into the module's embedded-source metadata. Ignore hits there; the evidence is the
allocation line and the instruction in `main`.
